description: This file defines IPC channel classes for client and server communication, including factory management, connection handling, and message invocation within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: IPCChannelClientType
classes.description: Template class for client-side IPC channel handling, supporting internal/external factory creation, connection management, and state changes.

classes.name: IPCChannelServerType
classes.description: Template class for server-side IPC channel management, handling client connections, message invocation, factory creation, and cleanup.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the IPC channel or socket with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the IPC channel or socket with a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the IPC channel or socket is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the IPC channel or socket is closed.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory for IPC elements with an initial size.

methods.name: DestroyFactory
methods.description: Destroys the factory for IPC elements.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a command on the client or server with a wait time.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up client connections and resources.
